purpose: Development-only validation of production release packaging and user-scoped install lifecycle
notes: This artifact is not a production release because the source tree was intentionally dirty during validation.
Production release.ps1 refuses dirty or untracked V2 source by default.

Authenticode was subsequently made optional for production by explicit product policy; unsigned packages remain protected by manifest, per-file SHA-256, and archive SHA-256 integrity checks. See production-hardening-2026-09-25.json.
